response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY account_id), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), acct AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, cu.town_city FROM counts c JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = c.account_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE cu.town_city IS NOT NULL), town AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(cnt) AS town_cnt FROM acct GROUP BY town_city) SELECT acct.account_id, acct.town_city, acct.cnt AS num_transactions, acct.cnt * 1.0 / town.town_cnt AS share_of_town_transactions, acct.cnt / avgc.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_average FROM acct JOIN town ON town.town_city = acct.town_city CROSS JOIN avgc ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average count per account is taken over accounts that have at least one transaction (the counts-by-account set), computed before dropping accounts with no customer or no town.

A town is identified by town_city alone (not combined with state or country), and an account's share of its town is its count divided by the total transactions of all accounts held by customers in that town.
Ties in the ratio are broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: The average count per account is over all accounts, including those with no transactions (total transactions ÷ number of Accounts rows).
alternatives.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY account_id), avgc AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Financial_Transactions) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts) AS avg_cnt), acct AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, cu.town_city FROM counts c JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = c.account_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE cu.town_city IS NOT NULL), town AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(cnt) AS town_cnt FROM acct GROUP BY town_city) SELECT acct.account_id, acct.town_city, acct.cnt AS num_transactions, acct.cnt * 1.0 / town.town_cnt AS share_of_town_transactions, acct.cnt / avgc.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_average FROM acct JOIN town ON town.town_city = acct.town_city CROSS JOIN avgc ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10;
